verdict.rationale: Azure does provide a public status page (azure.status.microsoft) showing current health and stating 'no active events,' but there is no evidence of per-service historical uptime data or detailed post-incident reports, and community hands-on reports directly contradict the page's reliability — during a real outage affecting production systems and SSO/Identity services, users found the status page 'never red' and 'absolutely useless,' with links pointing to the down portal itself. missing for 10: per-service historical uptime records, published post-incident report (PIR) archive, evidence the status page accurately reflects real-time outages.
